gloss_en: Abraham (Avraham) the biblical patriarch, who in Likutey Moharan embodies chesed (lovingkindness), love (ahavah), faith, and the 'right side' — the archetype of the attribute of loving devotion

outliers.actual_gloss_en: limbs/organs (of the body), as in the 248 limbs corresponding to the 248 positive commandments
outliers.reason: Proof at lm2:26 is entirely about Moshe being clothed in each of Israel's 248 limbs; Abraham is not the subject. The partner רמ"ח איברים indicates the matched word is really אֵבָרִים (limbs), a different word sharing letters — a homograph/mis-assignment.
